1	# DeepSeek-V2: Efficient MoE Language Model with Multi-Head Latent Attention
     2	
     3	## Source
     4	https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.04434
     5	
     6	## Model Overview
     7	
     8	DeepSeek-V2 is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 236B total parameters, of which only 21B are activated per token. It supports a 128K-token context length. The model was pretrained on 8.1T tokens from a high-quality, multi-source corpus with extended Chinese data. Post-training includes Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on 1.5M conversational sessions and Reinforcement Learning via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO).
     9	
    10	Compared with DeepSeek 67B (a dense predecessor), DeepSeek-V2 delivers:
    11	- **42.5% reduction** in training costs
    12	- **93.3% reduction** in KV cache size
    13	- **5.76× higher** maximum generation throughput
    14	
    15	## Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA)
    16	
    17	Conventional Multi-Head Attention (MHA) stores full key-value pairs per head per token, creating a KV cache bottleneck during autoregressive generation. Alternatives like Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) and Multi-Query Attention (MQA) reduce cache but sacrifice performance.
    18	
    19	MLA introduces **low-rank key-value joint compression**: instead of caching full K and V vectors, MLA compresses them into a compact latent vector $\mathbf{c}_t^{KV}$, which is cached during inference. Full keys, values, and a decoupled RoPE-based positional key are reconstructed on-the-fly via learned projection matrices. This yields **better performance than MHA** while requiring dramatically less cache.
    20	
    21	![Attention mechanism comparison: MHA vs GQA vs MQA vs MLA](./assets/figure_2.jpg)
    22	
    23	## DeepSeekMoE Architecture
    24	
    25	The FFN layers use the DeepSeekMoE design with two expert types:
    26	- **Shared experts** ($N_s$): always activated, capture common knowledge
    27	- **Routed experts** ($N_r$): sparsely activated via a top-$K_r$ router
    28	
    29	Fine-grained expert segmentation increases specialization potential. Device-limited routing constrains each token to experts on at most $M$ devices, reducing cross-node communication. Auxiliary losses enforce load balance across experts and devices, and a token-dropping strategy during training prevents expert overflow without affecting inference.
    30	
    31	![DeepSeek-V2 architecture diagram](./assets/figure_1.jpg)
    32	
    33	## Performance Benchmarks
    34	
    35	DeepSeek-V2 achieves top-tier MMLU performance among open-source models while activating far fewer parameters than competitors.
    36	
    37	| Model | Activated Params (B) | MMLU Score |
    38	|---|---|---|
    39	| DeepSeek-V2 | 21 | 78.5 |
    40	| LLaMA 3 70B | 70 | 77.0 |
    41	| Mixtral 8x22B | 39 | 77.6 |
    42	| Qwen1.5 72B | 72 | 75.6 |
    43	| DeepSeek 67B | 67 | 73.0 |
    44	| LLaMA 2 70B | 70 | 69.0 |
    45	| Mixtral 8x7B | 13 | 70.6 |
    46	| LLaMA 3 8B | 8 | 65.0 |
    47	
    48	![MMLU vs activated parameters](./assets/figure_3.jpg)
    49	
    50	## Alignment and Chat Evaluation
    51	
    52	After SFT and GRPO-based RL, DeepSeek-V2 Chat (RL) achieves strong results on open-ended conversation benchmarks:
    53	
    54	| Benchmark | DeepSeek-V2 Chat (RL) |
    55	|---|---|
    56	| AlpacaEval 2.0 (length-controlled win rate) | 38.9% |
    57	| MT-Bench (overall) | 8.97 |
    58	| AlignBench (overall, Chinese) | 7.91 |
    59	
    60	On AlignBench (Chinese), DeepSeek-V2 Chat (RL) outperforms all open-source models and most closed-source models, demonstrating exceptional multilingual alignment quality.
    61	
    62	## Key Findings
    63	
    64	- **MLA achieves superior performance to MHA** while reducing KV cache by 93.3%, making it a strictly better alternative to GQA/MQA for inference efficiency.
    65	- **DeepSeekMoE with fine-grained experts and shared expert isolation** enables training a 236B-parameter model at 42.5% lower cost than a 67B dense model.
    66	- **Only 21B activated parameters** are needed to match or exceed 70B-class dense models (LLaMA 3 70B, Qwen1.5 72B) on MMLU.
    67	- **5.76× throughput improvement** over DeepSeek 67B makes DeepSeek-V2 practical for large-scale deployment.
    68	- **DeepSeek-V2 Chat (RL) is the strongest open-source chat model in Chinese** and competitive with closed-source systems in English open-ended evaluation.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate DeepSeek-V2 technical presentation."""

import os
from io import BytesIO

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.dml.color import RgbColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constants
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
SLIDE_WIDTH = Inches(13.333)
SLIDE_HEIGHT = Inches(7.5)

# Color palette (dark tech theme)
BG = RgbColor(0x0D, 0x11, 0x17)          # near-black background
ACCENT = RgbColor(0x00, 0xC8, 0xFF)      # cyan accent
TEXT = RgbColor(0xE8, 0xEC, 0xF0)        # off-white body text
SUBTEXT = RgbColor(0x8A, 0x92, 0x9E)     # muted grey
HIGHLIGHT = RgbColor(0xFF, 0xB0, 0x00)   # amber highlight

ASSETS_DIR = "/app/benchmark/assets"
OUTPUT_PATH = "/app/output/final_deck.pptx"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def set_slide_bg(slide, color=BG):
    background = slide.background
    fill = background.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color


def add_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18,
                bold=False, color=TEXT, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font_name="Calibri"):
    tf = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height).text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.alignment = align
    run = p.runs[0]
    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold = bold
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.name = font_name
    return tf


def add_bullet_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, bullets,
                       font_size=16, color=TEXT, bullet_color=ACCENT,
                       font_name="Calibri"):
    tf = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height).text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, txt in enumerate(bullets):
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        p.text = txt
        p.level = 0
        p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
        p.font.color.rgb = color
        p.font.name = font_name
        p.space_after = Pt(10)
    return tf


def add_shape_bar(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape


def make_mmlu_scatter() -> BytesIO:
    """Create a scatter plot of MMLU vs Activated Parameters."""
    data = [
        ("DeepSeek-V2", 21, 78.5, True),
        ("LLaMA 3 70B", 70, 77.0, False),
        ("Mixtral 8×22B", 39, 77.6, False),
        ("Qwen1.5 72B", 72, 75.6, False),
        ("DeepSeek 67B", 67, 73.0, False),
        ("LLaMA 2 70B", 70, 69.0, False),
        ("Mixtral 8×7B", 13, 70.6, False),
        ("LLaMA 3 8B", 8, 65.0, False),
    ]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 4.2), facecolor='#0D1117')
    ax.set_facecolor('#0D1117')

    for name, params, mmlu, highlight in data:
        color = '#FFB000' if highlight else '#00C8FF'
        size = 120 if highlight else 70
        ax.scatter(params, mmlu, s=size, c=color, edgecolors='#E8ECF0', linewidths=0.8, zorder=3)
        offset = (4, 4) if name != "DeepSeek-V2" else (4, -10)
        ax.annotate(name, (params, mmlu), textcoords="offset points", xytext=offset,
                    fontsize=8 if not highlight else 9, color='#E8ECF0', fontweight='bold' if highlight else 'normal')

    ax.set_xlabel("Activated Parameters (B)", color='#E8ECF0', fontsize=11)
    ax.set_ylabel("MMLU Score", color='#E8ECF0', fontsize=11)
    ax.tick_params(colors='#8A929E', which='both')
    ax.spines['bottom'].set_color('#8A929E')
    ax.spines['left'].set_color('#8A929E')
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    ax.set_xlim(0, 80)
    ax.set_ylim(60, 82)
    ax.grid(True, color='#1F2937', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5, zorder=1)

    # Pareto frontier annotation
    ax.annotate("Pareto-optimal frontier", xy=(21, 78.5), xytext=(35, 80.5),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#FFB000', lw=1.2),
                fontsize=9, color='#FFB000', fontweight='bold')

    plt.tight_layout()
    buf = BytesIO()
    fig.savefig(buf, format='png', dpi=200, facecolor='#0D1117', edgecolor='none')
    plt.close(fig)
    buf.seek(0)
    return buf


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Slide builders
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def build_title_slide(prs):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])  # blank
    set_slide_bg(slide)
    # Accent bar top
    add_shape_bar(slide, Inches(0), Inches(0), SLIDE_WIDTH, Inches(0.08), ACCENT)
    # Title
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(2.2), Inches(11.7), Inches(1.2),
                "DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient MoE Language Model",
                font_size=40, bold=True, color=TEXT, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)
    # Subtitle stats
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(3.6), Inches(11.7), Inches(0.6),
                "236B total parameters  ·  21B activated per token  ·  128K context length",
                font_size=22, bold=False, color=ACCENT, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)
    # Attribution
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(6.4), Inches(11.7), Inches(0.5),
                "arXiv:2405.04434  ·  DeepSeek-AI",
                font_size=14, bold=False, color=SUBTEXT, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)


def build_motivation_slide(prs):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    set_slide_bg(slide)
    add_shape_bar(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.15), Inches(0.25), Inches(0.45), ACCENT)
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(1.15), Inches(1.1), Inches(11), Inches(0.6),
                "The LLM Scaling Dilemma: Performance vs. Training Cost and Inference Speed",
                font_size=30, bold=True, color=TEXT)

    bullets = [
        "• Larger dense models improve capability but scale costs super-linearly in training FLOPs and memory.",
        "• Autoregressive inference is bottlenecked by the KV cache: full key–value vectors per head per token explode memory bandwidth.",
        "• Existing shortcuts (MQA, GQA) shrink cache but measurably degrade attention capacity.",
        "• MoE promises sparse activation, yet communication overhead and load imbalance often erode the savings.",
        "• Need: an architecture that is simultaneously cheaper to train, faster to generate, and stronger at evaluation."
    ]
    add_bullet_textbox(slide, Inches(0.9), Inches(2.0), Inches(11.5), Inches(4.8), bullets, font_size=18)


def build_architecture_slide(prs):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    set_slide_bg(slide)
    add_shape_bar(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.15), Inches(0.25), Inches(0.45), ACCENT)
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(1.15), Inches(1.1), Inches(11), Inches(0.6),
                "DeepSeek-V2 Architecture: MLA + DeepSeekMoE in a Transformer Block",
                font_size=30, bold=True, color=TEXT)

    img_path = os.path.join(ASSETS_DIR, "figure_1.jpg")
    if os.path.exists(img_path):
        slide.shapes.add_picture(img_path, Inches(1.0), Inches(1.9), width=Inches(11.3))
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.9), Inches(6.5), Inches(11.5), Inches(0.6),
                "Each layer replaces dense MHA with Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) and dense FFN with DeepSeekMoE.",
                font_size=16, color=SUBTEXT)


def build_mla_slide(prs):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    set_slide_bg(slide)
    add_shape_bar(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.15), Inches(0.25), Inches(0.45), ACCENT)
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(1.15), Inches(1.1), Inches(11), Inches(0.6),
                "Multi-Head Latent Attention Compresses KV Cache by 93.3%",
                font_size=30, bold=True, color=TEXT)

    # Left: bullets
    bullets = [
        "• Instead of caching full K and V vectors per head, MLA compresses them into a compact latent vector c_t^KV.",
        "• Full keys, values, and a decoupled RoPE-based positional key are reconstructed on-the-fly via learned projections.",
        "• Result: better performance than standard MHA with dramatically less cache — strictly dominating GQA/MQA.",
        "• KV cache reduction: 93.3% vs. conventional MHA."
    ]
    add_bullet_textbox(slide, Inches(0.9), Inches(2.0), Inches(5.8), Inches(4.5), bullets, font_size=17)

    # Right: figure
    img_path = os.path.join(ASSETS_DIR, "figure_2.jpg")
    if os.path.exists(img_path):
        slide.shapes.add_picture(img_path, Inches(6.9), Inches(2.0), width=Inches(5.8))


def build_deepseek_moe_slide(prs):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    set_slide_bg(slide)
    add_shape_bar(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.15), Inches(0.25), Inches(0.45), ACCENT)
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(1.15), Inches(1.1), Inches(11), Inches(0.6),
                "DeepSeekMoE: Fine-Grained Experts with Shared Expert Isolation",
                font_size=30, bold=True, color=TEXT)

    bullets = [
        "• Shared experts (N_s): always activated, capture common knowledge across all tokens.",
        "• Routed experts (N_r): sparsely activated via a top-K_r router, enabling massive parameter counts with modest per-token FLOPs.",
        "• Fine-grained expert segmentation increases specialization potential without increasing active parameters.",
        "• Device-limited routing constrains each token to experts on at most M devices, cutting cross-node communication.",
        "• Auxiliary losses enforce load balance across experts and devices; token dropping during training prevents overflow without affecting inference."
    ]
    add_bullet_textbox(slide, Inches(0.9), Inches(2.0), Inches(11.5), Inches(4.8), bullets, font_size=18)


def build_efficiency_slide(prs):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    set_slide_bg(slide)
    add_shape_bar(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.15), Inches(0.25), Inches(0.45), ACCENT)
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(1.15), Inches(1.1), Inches(11), Inches(0.6),
                "42.5% Training Cost Reduction and 5.76× Generation Throughput vs. DeepSeek 67B",
                font_size=30, bold=True, color=TEXT)

    # Side-by-side comparison boxes
    box_w = Inches(5.2)
    box_h = Inches(3.6)
    left_x = Inches(1.2)
    right_x = Inches(7.0)
    top_y = Inches(2.1)

    # DeepSeek 67B box (reference)
    shape_left = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, left_x, top_y, box_w, box_h)
    shape_left.fill.solid()
    shape_left.fill.fore_color.rgb = RgbColor(0x16, 0x20, 0x2A)
    shape_left.line.color.rgb = SUBTEXT
    shape_left.line.width = Pt(1)

    tf_left = shape_left.text_frame
    tf_left.word_wrap = True
    p = tf_left.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = "DeepSeek 67B (Dense)"
    p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    p.font.size = Pt(22)
    p.font.bold = True
    p.font.color.rgb = SUBTEXT
    p.font.name = "Calibri"

    p2 = tf_left.add_paragraph()
    p2.text = "\nBaseline dense predecessor"
    p2.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    p2.font.size = Pt(16)
    p2.font.color.rgb = SUBTEXT

    # DeepSeek-V2 box (improved)
    shape_right = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, right_x, top_y, box_w, box_h)
    shape_right.fill.solid()
    shape_right.fill.fore_color.rgb = RgbColor(0x10, 0x24, 0x2E)
    shape_right.line.color.rgb = ACCENT
    shape_right.line.width = Pt(2)

    tf_right = shape_right.text_frame
    tf_right.word_wrap = True
    p = tf_right.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = "DeepSeek-V2 (MoE + MLA)"
    p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    p.font.size = Pt(22)
    p.font.bold = True
    p.font.color.rgb = ACCENT
    p.font.name = "Calibri"

    metrics = [
        ("Training cost", "↓ 42.5%", HIGHLIGHT),
        ("KV cache size", "↓ 93.3%", HIGHLIGHT),
        ("Max generation throughput", "↑ 5.76×", HIGHLIGHT),
    ]
    for label, value, vcolor in metrics:
        pl = tf_right.add_paragraph()
        pl.text = f"\n{label}: {value}"
        pl.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
        pl.font.size = Pt(18)
        pl.font.color.rgb = TEXT
        # Make the value bold/highlight by splitting (simpler: just color the whole line)
        # We'll keep it as-is for simplicity; the value stands out via the label.

    # Bottom note
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.9), Inches(6.2), Inches(11.5), Inches(0.5),
                "All metrics are relative improvements over the DeepSeek 67B dense baseline. No absolute FLOPs or cache sizes are stated.",
                font_size=13, color=SUBTEXT, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)


def build_mmlu_slide(prs):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    set_slide_bg(slide)
    add_shape_bar(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.15), Inches(0.25), Inches(0.45), ACCENT)
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(1.15), Inches(1.1), Inches(11), Inches(0.6),
                "DeepSeek-V2 Tops MMLU Among Open-Source Models at Only 21B Activated Parameters",
                font_size=28, bold=True, color=TEXT)

    # Insert scatter chart
    chart_buf = make_mmlu_scatter()
    slide.shapes.add_picture(chart_buf, Inches(0.7), Inches(1.85), width=Inches(7.4))

    # Right-side data table
    table_left = Inches(8.3)
    table_top = Inches(2.0)
    rows, cols = 9, 3
    table = slide.shapes.add_table(rows, cols, table_left, table_top, Inches(4.2), Inches(4.2)).table

    # Column widths
    table.columns[0].width = Inches(2.2)
    table.columns[1].width = Inches(1.0)
    table.columns[2].width = Inches(1.0)

    headers = ["Model", "Act. Params", "MMLU"]
    for i, h in enumerate(headers):
        cell = table.cell(0, i)
        cell.text = h
        cell.fill.solid()
        cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = RgbColor(0x16, 0x20, 0x2A)
        for paragraph in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
            paragraph.font.size = Pt(13)
            paragraph.font.bold = True
            paragraph.font.color.rgb = ACCENT
            paragraph.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER

    data_rows = [
        ("DeepSeek-V2", "21", "78.5"),
        ("LLaMA 3 70B", "70", "77.0"),
        ("Mixtral 8×22B", "39", "77.6"),
        ("Qwen1.5 72B", "72", "75.6"),
        ("DeepSeek 67B", "67", "73.0"),
        ("LLaMA 2 70B", "70", "69.0"),
        ("Mixtral 8×7B", "13", "70.6"),
        ("LLaMA 3 8B", "8", "65.0"),
    ]
    for r_idx, (name, params, mmlu) in enumerate(data_rows, start=1):
        highlight = name == "DeepSeek-V2"
        bg = RgbColor(0x1A, 0x24, 0x2E) if highlight else BG
        for c_idx, val in enumerate([name, params, mmlu]):
            cell = table.cell(r_idx, c_idx)
            cell.text = val
            cell.fill.solid()
            cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = bg
            for paragraph in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
                paragraph.font.size = Pt(12)
                paragraph.font.bold = highlight
                paragraph.font.color.rgb = HIGHLIGHT if highlight else TEXT
                paragraph.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER if c_idx > 0 else PP_ALIGN.LEFT

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(8.3), Inches(6.35), Inches(4.2), Inches(0.4),
                "Lower-right = more efficient. DeepSeek-V2 is Pareto-optimal.",
                font_size=13, color=SUBTEXT, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)


def build_alignment_slide(prs):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    set_slide_bg(slide)
    add_shape_bar(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.15), Inches(0.25), Inches(0.45), ACCENT)
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(1.15), Inches(1.1), Inches(11), Inches(0.6),
                "DeepSeek-V2 Chat (RL) Rivals Closed-Source Models on Chinese Benchmarks",
                font_size=28, bold=True, color=TEXT)

    bullets = [
        "• Alignment pipeline: Supervised Fine-Tuning on 1.5M conversational sessions, followed by GRPO-based Reinforcement Learning.",
        "• AlpacaEval 2.0 (length-controlled win rate): 38.9%",
        "• MT-Bench (overall): 8.97",
        "• AlignBench (overall, Chinese): 7.91 — outperforming all open-source and most closed-source models in Chinese evaluation.",
        "• Demonstrates that architectural efficiency and post-training quality are not mutually exclusive."
    ]
    add_bullet_textbox(slide, Inches(0.9), Inches(2.0), Inches(11.5), Inches(4.5), bullets, font_size=18)


def build_takeaways_slide(prs):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    set_slide_bg(slide)
    add_shape_bar(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.15), Inches(0.25), Inches(0.45), ACCENT)
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(1.15), Inches(1.1), Inches(11), Inches(0.6),
                "Key Takeaways: Architectural Innovation Unlocks Efficient Scaling",
                font_size=30, bold=True, color=TEXT)

    bullets = [
        "1. MLA is a strictly better KV-cache solution: 93.3% reduction with superior performance to MHA, dominating GQA/MQA.",
        "2. DeepSeekMoE enables economical training of a 236B-parameter model at 42.5% lower cost than a 67B dense model.",
        "3. Only 21B activated parameters match or exceed 70B-class dense models on MMLU — a Pareto-optimal trade-off.",
        "4. 5.76× throughput improvement over DeepSeek 67B makes large-scale deployment practical.",
        "5. DeepSeek-V2 Chat (RL) is the strongest open-source chat model in Chinese and competitive with closed-source systems in English."
    ]
    add_bullet_textbox(slide, Inches(0.9), Inches(2.0), Inches(11.5), Inches(4.8), bullets, font_size=19)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main():
    prs = Presentation()
    prs.slide_width = SLIDE_WIDTH
    prs.slide_height = SLIDE_HEIGHT

    build_title_slide(prs)
    build_motivation_slide(prs)
    build_architecture_slide(prs)
    build_mla_slide(prs)
    build_deepseek_moe_slide(prs)
    build_efficiency_slide(prs)
    build_mmlu_slide(prs)
    build_alignment_slide(prs)
    build_takeaways_slide(prs)

    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUTPUT_PATH), exist_ok=True)
    prs.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
    print(f"Saved presentation to {OUTPUT_PATH}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
